mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_task_event (user_id, task_id, event_seq, producer_key, event_type, payload_json, occurred_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{taskId}, 1, #{producerKey}, 'task.accepted', #{payloadJson}, #{occurredAt})

INSERT INTO sq_task_event (user_id, task_id, event_seq, producer_key, event_type, payload_json, occurred_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{taskId}, #{sequence}, #{producerKey}, #{eventType}, #{payloadJson}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT event_seq, task_id, event_type, payload_json, occurred_at FROM sq_task_event WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND event_seq > #{after} ORDER BY event_seq LIMIT 100

SELECT event_seq, task_id, event_type, payload_json, occurred_at FROM sq_task_event WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND event_type IN ('answer.completed', 'answer.replaced') ORDER BY event_seq DESC LIMIT 1
